data.desc: United Bankshares, Inc. ('United') (NASDAQ: UBSI ) is a financial services company with consolidated assets of approximately $34 billion as of September 30, 2026. United is the 35th largest banking company in the U.S. based on market capitalization. United is the parent company of United Bank, which has over 240 offices located across Washington, D.C., Virginia, West Virginia, Maryland, North Carolina, South Carolina, Ohio, Pennsylvania, and Georgia. For more information, visit ubsi-inc.com.
